pretreatment: Polished (100) silicon wafers were used as substrates for film thickness measurements and x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy analysis (XPS). Teonex VR PEN (Polyethylene naphthalate) from DuPont Teijin with thickness of 125 lm, which is the most popular polymer that has been used for flexible displays, was used as a polymer substrate for WVTR measurements.
